notes: No starting section posted. The strategy says 'Always Start Signal and ANSB'; A New Secret Base deploys on the 1st marker, so Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker) is the starting location (same reading as 14659 and 14770). The Signal's starting text deploys A New Secret Base. All are in the list and count toward the 60. Total 60.
The post says Steve Baroni built the deck and Mike Gemme played it ('he ... didn't play it, i did'); credited to Gemme as poster and player.
The strategy mentions playing it on a Sunday for a PlayStation 2 prize (a tournament report); no event is named.
